text:
kevin chen: quick heads-up — PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/10422|#10422> is ready for review but it's gated on an architecture note / RFC. can someone from arch skim and say if a lightweight anchor will unblock merge?
lina p: link the RFC draft pls, or at least 2 bullets on safety/SLO impact. without that engops won't greenlight the canary.
kevin chen: putting draft here: https://docs.internal.redwood/rfcs/draft-model-routing-caching — still WIP, but i added rationale and rollout plan section.
archana: thanks — i'll take a look. quick ask: does this change cross-tenant cache behavior or only within a single tenant pool?
kevin chen: only intra-tenant cache. we add a new shard affinity header and a best-effort prefix cache. no cross-tenant sharing.
tim o'neil: fyi from SRE: need an SLO delta estimate. if this increases 95th latency in slow-path we may need a longer canary. can you add a table with expected 95/99 lat numbers pre/post?
kevin chen: yes, i'll add a short table. baseline p95 is 78ms, expected p95 for hot-key hits ~62ms (improvement) but cold-path p95 might go to ~130ms for some model variants.
aj: CI is failing a flaky test on perf harness, looks unrelated but want to call it out.
ci-bot: build #4821: tests/fuzz_perf harness — failed (timeout).
maria g: would it help to do a 2-hour canary with traffic shaping instead of full ramp? ops can schedule the window if arch gives a quick OK.
archana: i can give a lightweight blessing if you attach the RFC URL in the PR and add the SLO delta table. post those two items and ping me, i'll approve with 2 bullet signoff (scope + fallback).
kevin chen: copying checklist: 1) attach RFC link in PR body, 2) add SLO delta table, 3) add fallback route note (already in PR). will update in next push. pinging when done. :thumbsup:
lina p: great — also please call out the canary window you'd like (2h vs 4h) and rollback criteria. that avoids back-and-forth with ops.
kevin chen: leaning 2h canary with 10%->50% steps, rollback if p95 > baseline+40ms or error rate > 0.5%. will add to PR.
archana: perfect. once you update i'll do a quick read and drop a :white_check_mark:.
kevin chen: done — PR updated, RFC link in body and SLO table added. pinging @archana.
archana: looked — scope matches, fallback and rollback criteria look sensible. giving lightweight arch blessing: "scope: intra-tenant cache + shard-affinity; fallback: disable affinity header; rollout: 2h canary." :white_check_mark:
maria g: ops can take the 2h slot tomorrow 11:00-13:00 PT. scheduling now.
kevin chen: thank you all. merging after ops confirms schedule and CI green.
ci-bot: build #4823: all checks passed.
kevin chen: merging now. :shipit:
